items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 225:1
items.html: The second restriction is the secret of the association of the quality of mercy with judgment, for Malchut, which is the quality of judgment, was joined with Bina, which is the quality of mercy, as it is said, "and the two of them went". And this caused the second restriction in the worlds. For at first the world was created with the quality of judgment, because the screen was corrected in the vessel of Malchut, which is the quality of judgment, and the first nine were clean of the restriction. And when Malchut ascended to Bina, the screen was made in the openings of the eyes, and it brought out the AHP from the ten Sefirot of the head, to the aspect of a body. And likewise, the concluding Malchut ascended to the half of the Bina of the body, and brought out the TNHY into the empty void, for the restriction was made in the place of the Parsa of Atzilut. (Item 3, and in the Inner Light, Sub Header, "and he raised").
